description: The real, validated HOOS, JR. (Hip disability and Osteoarthritis Outcome Score for Joint Replacement) instrument, English version 1.0, copyright 2016 Hospital for Special Surgery -- not a hackathon approximation. All 6 items use the same None/Mild/Moderate/Severe/Extreme scale, framed by the source survey as: pain items ask 'What amount of hip pain have you experienced the last week during the following activities?'; function items ask for 'the degree of difficulty you have experienced in the last week due to your hip.' Hip-specific (not knee) -- KOOS JR is this instrument's knee counterpart, not included here. Sourced from the source PDF; production/commercial use of this instrument requires confirming licensing terms with Hospital for Special Surgery, distinct from using it in this hackathon demo for its stated clinical purpose.

questions.topic: hip pain going up or down stairs
questions.prompt_text: Over the past week, how much hip pain have you experienced going up or down stairs?

questions.topic: hip pain walking on an uneven surface
questions.prompt_text: Over the past week, how much hip pain have you experienced walking on an uneven surface?
Over the past week, how much difficulty have you had rising from sitting because of your hip?

questions.topic: difficulty bending to the floor or picking up an object
questions.prompt_text: Over the past week, how much difficulty have you had bending to the floor or picking up an object because of your hip?
Over the past week, how much difficulty have you had lying in bed -- turning over or maintaining your hip position -- because of your hip?
Over the past week, how much difficulty have you had sitting because of your hip?
